name: pl-civet
title: CIVET Human Brain-Imaging Pipeline
description: CIVET is an image processing pipeline for fully automated volumetric,corticometric, and morphometric analysis of human brain imaging data (MRI).

parameters.name: -spawn
parameters.help: Use the perl system interface to spawn jobs [default: use local host scheduler DEFAULT]

parameters.name: -queue
parameters.help: Which queue to use

parameters.name: -hosts
parameters.help: Colon separated list of hosts

parameters.name: -qopts
parameters.help: Extra options to queuing system

parameters.name: -no-granular
parameters.help: Granularity level for submission of jobs using queueing system. [default]

parameters.name: -granular
parameters.help: opposite of -no-granular

parameters.name: -maxqueued
parameters.help: Maximum number of jobs that can be submitted at once. [default: 10000]

parameters.name: -mpi
parameters.help: Submit jobs using mpirun to fill all processors on core.

parameters.name: -no-mpi
parameters.help: opposite of -mpi [default]

parameters.name: -sourcedir
parameters.help: Directory containing the source files.

parameters.name: -targetdir
parameters.help: Directory where processed data will be placed.

parameters.name: -prefix
parameters.help: File prefix to be used in naming output files.

parameters.name: -id-subdir
parameters.help: Indicate that the source directory contains sub-directories for each id

parameters.name: -id-file
parameters.help: A text file that contains all the subject id's (separated by space, tab, return or comma) that CIVET will run on.

parameters.name: -template
parameters.help: Define the template for image processing in stereotaxic space (0.50, 0.75, 1.00, 1.50, 2.00, 3.00, 4.00, 6.00). [default: 1.00]

parameters.name: -model
parameters.help: Define the model for image-processing: "colin27" (MNI Colin27 asymmetric (2009)), "icbm152nl_09s" (MNI ICBM152 non-linear symmetric (2009a)), "icbm152nl" (MNI ICBM152 non-linear 6th generation), "icbm152lin" (MNI ICBM152 linear), "ibis-v24" (MNI IBIS 24 months, symmetric (2015)), "ADNIhires" (MNI ADNI non-linear hi-res sym 0.5mm)  [default: icbm152nl_09s]

parameters.name: -surfreg-model
parameters.help: Define the model for surface registration: "icbm152MCsym" (ICBM152, marching-cubes, symmetric (2014)), "colinMCasym" (Colin, marching-cubes, asymmetric (2014)), "samirMCasym" (IBIS Phantom (Samir), marching-cubes, asymmetric (2014))

parameters.name: -surface-atlas
parameters.help: Define the atlas for surface parcellation: "lobes" (coarse lobar parcellation, symmetric), "AAL" (AAL parcellation, asymmetric, based on Colin brain), "DKT" (DKT-40 parcellation, asymmetric) [default: lobes]

parameters.name: -input_is_stx
parameters.help: Assume that the input volume is already linearly registered to stx space; this skips the linear registration steps (applies to all of T1, T2, PD)

parameters.name: -noinput_is_stx
parameters.help: opposite of -input_is_stx [default]

parameters.name: -multispectral
parameters.help: Use T1, T2 and PD native files for tissue classification.

parameters.name: -correct-pve
parameters.help: Apply correction to the mean and variance of tissue types at pve iterations. [default]

parameters.name: -no-correct-pve
parameters.help: opposite of -correct-pve

parameters.name: -mask-cerebellum
parameters.help: mask cerebellum and brainstem from pve classification [default]

parameters.name: -no-mask-cerebellum
parameters.help: opposite of -mask-cerebellum

parameters.name: -subcortical
parameters.help: create a sub-cortical SC class in pve classification [default]

parameters.name: -no-subcortical
parameters.help: opposite of -subcortical

parameters.name: -calibrate-white
parameters.help: Apply gradient intensity correction for calibration of white surface. [default]

parameters.name: -no-calibrate-white
parameters.help: opposite of -calibrate-white

parameters.name: -spectral_mask
parameters.help: Use T1, T2 and PD stereotaxic files for brain masking.

parameters.name: -interp
parameters.help: Interpolation method from native to stereotaxic space ("trilinear", "tricubic", "sinc") [default: trilinear]

parameters.name: -headheight
parameters.help: head height in mm for neck cropping (use 0 for none). [default: 175]

parameters.name: -N3-distance
parameters.help: N3 spline distance in mm (suggested values: 200 for 1.5T scan; 50 for 3T scan).

parameters.name: -N3-damping
parameters.help: N3 damping coefficient (lambda) (suggested values: 2.0e-06). [default: 2.0e-06]

parameters.name: -lsq6
parameters.help: use 6-parameter transformation for linear registration [default -lsq9]

parameters.name: -lsq12
parameters.help: use 12-parameter transformation for linear registration [default -lsq9]

parameters.name: -no-surfaces
parameters.help: don't build surfaces

parameters.name: -hi-res-surfaces
parameters.help: build high resolution surfaces

parameters.name: -mask-blood-vessels
parameters.help: mask blood vessels prior to white surface extraction

parameters.name: -no-mask-blood-vessel
parameters.help: opposite of -mask-blood-vessels [default]

parameters.name: -mask-hippocampus
parameters.help: mask hippocampus and amygdala for surface extraction if model supports it [default]

parameters.name: -no-mask-hippocampus
parameters.help: opposite of -mask-hippocampus

parameters.name: -thickness
parameters.help: compute cortical thickness and blur [tlink][:tlaplace][:tfs] [fwhm1][:fwhm2]:...[:fwhmN] kernel sizes in mm [default: tlink 30]

parameters.name: -resample-surfaces
parameters.help: resample cortical surfaces

parameters.name: -no-resample-surfaces
parameters.help: opposite of -resample-surfaces [default]

parameters.name: -mean-curvature
parameters.help: produce mean curvature maps on surfaces

parameters.name: -no-mean-curvature
parameters.help: opposite of -mean-curvature [default]

parameters.name: -area-fwhm
parameters.help: fwhm1:fwhm2:...:fwhmn blurring kernel sizes in mm for resampled surface areas [default: 40]

parameters.name: -volume-fwhm
parameters.help: fwhm1:fwhm2:...:fwhmn blurring kernel sizes in mm for resampled surface volumes [default: 40]

parameters.name: -combine-surfaces
parameters.help: combine left and right cortical surfaces

parameters.name: -no-combine-surfaces
parameters.help: opposite of -combine-surfaces [default]

parameters.name: -VBM
parameters.help: process VBM files for analysis [default -no-VBM]

parameters.name: -no-VBM
parameters.help: don't process VBM files for analysis

parameters.name: -VBM-fwhm
parameters.help: blurring kernel size in mm for volume [default: 8]

parameters.name: -VBM-symmetry
parameters.help: run symmetry tools [default -no-VBM-symmetry]

parameters.name: -no-VBM-symmetry
parameters.help: don't run symmetry tools

parameters.name: -VBM-cerebellum
parameters.help: keep cerebellum in VBM maps

parameters.name: -no-VBM-cerebellum
parameters.help: mask out cerebellum in VBM maps [default -VBM-cerebellum]

parameters.name: -run
parameters.help: Run the pipeline.

parameters.name: -status-from-files
parameters.help: Compute pipeline status from files

parameters.name: -print-stages
parameters.help: Print the pipeline stages.

parameters.name: -print-status
parameters.help: Print the status of each pipeline.

parameters.name: -make-graph
parameters.help: Create dot graph file.

parameters.name: -make-filename-graph
parameters.help: Create dot graph of filenames.

parameters.name: -print-status-report
parameters.help: Writes a CSV status report to file in cwd.

parameters.name: -reset-all
parameters.help: Start the pipeline from the beginning.

parameters.name: -reset-from
parameters.help: Restart from the specified stage.

parameters.name: -reset-after
parameters.help: Restart after the specified stage.

parameters.name: -reset-to
parameters.help: Run up to and including the specified stage.

parameters.name: -reset-running
parameters.help: Restart currently running jobs. [default]

parameters.name: -no-reset-running
parameters.help: opposite of -reset-running
